name: record-value-test-1a630496b4/record-clear-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.map lists length, keys, hasKey, get, remove.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" lists map:length, map:keys, map:hasKey, map:get and map:remove; removeAll is listed only for array.
reason: The case asserts that clearing a Person record with required defaulted fields via person.removeAll() panics. This requires the map langlib removeAll operation, which is absent from both the supported map operations and supported langlib method-call list. Array removeAll support does not cover records.
unsupported_constructs: Record/map removeAll langlib method call and its required-field panic behavior
test_design_notes: The // @panic annotation asserts runtime panic from clearing the record; it is not merely a method-signature test.
